public.title: Function Length
public.description: Compute declared function length from a parameter descriptor. Parameters is an array of {kind}, with kind "required", "default" or "rest"; a rest parameter, if any, is last. Return the number of parameters preceding the first default or rest parameter, or the full count if neither occurs. At most 20 parameters. This models Function.length without evaluating user-provided JavaScript. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
